title: Existing abelian sheafification is left exact from locally bijective units
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with object universe u and arrow universe v. Suppose the inclusion of sheaves of abelian groups with values in universe w into presheaves admits a left adjoint [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and the maps inverted by this left adjoint are exactly the locally injective and locally surjective maps. Then that left adjoint preserves finite limits. No size relation among u, v, w is required.

source.place: Tag 00WJ, exactness of sheafification; Tag 03CN, proof of assertion (1) for abelian presheaves. The finite-refinement argument adapts these proofs to an already existing reflector in an arbitrary section universe.

proof.text: Finite limits of abelian presheaves are sectionwise. For a finite category K and a diagram D, the units give a comparison from lim D to the limit of the underlying sheafified diagram. To lift a section of the target locally, intersect the finite collection of image sieves for its components. Choose lifts on each arrow in that covering. For each of the finitely many diagram arrows, the two corresponding lifted components have the same image under the unit; its local injectivity yields a covering on which the compatibility equation holds. Refine all these coverings together. The compatible lifts define a section of lim D, proving local surjectivity of the comparison. Local injectivity follows by refining the finitely many equality sieves of components. The empty diagram is the terminal object, already a sheaf. The target limit is a sheaf, because the inclusion creates limits. WEqualsLocallyBijective says sheafification inverts the comparison. The counit on its target is an isomorphism, so the canonical finite-limit comparison for the given reflector is an isomorphism. Hence its left adjoint preserves finite limits, which with HasWeakSheafify gives HasSheafify. This argument uses only finite refinement, not existence of limits over coverings in the smaller universe.

proof_origin.description: A2, finite local lifting and equality refinement argument from Stacks 00WJ and 03CN, specialized to an existing abelian reflector without a site-size assumption.
